title: Cancel a personal watercraft (PWC) driving licence
summary: You can cancel your Personal Watercraft (PWC) licence at a Service NSW Centre, by mail, or by email.
intro:
If you want to cancel your Personal Watercraft (PWC) licence you can do this at a Service NSW Centre or by mail or email.

Note: A refund on your licence payment may be available in certain circumstances.
what_you_need: A written request to cancel your licence
Your current PWC licence (must be surrendered)
The Request For Refund Form (if applicable)

how_to_steps.text: Download and complete the Request for Refund (Maritime) – PDF (if applicable)
Visit a service centre and submit your application in person, or mail/email it using the details on the form.

external_links.text: Maritime proof of identity requirements – PDF
Boating and marine in NSW – Transport for NSW

faqs.q: How can I cancel my PWC licence?
faqs.a: You can cancel your PWC licence at a Service NSW Centre, or by mail or email.

faqs.q: Is a refund available if I cancel my licence?
faqs.a: A refund on your licence payment may be available in certain circumstances.

faqs.q: What do I need to cancel my PWC licence?
faqs.a: You need a written request to cancel your licence, proof of identity, your current PWC licence (which must be surrendered), and the Request For Refund Form (if applicable).
